about: Log line formats that LogShed's collectors know, shared by backend/tests/test_message_formats.py and frontend/src/test/Formatters.test.ts. line: a container line as Docker sends it. stored: the message the Docker collector stores for it. display: what the Console shows for both line and stored (cleanLogMessageForDisplay in frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts). When a collector learns a new format, add a case here, so the Console's tidying must handle it too.

cases.name: Stray control characters
cases.line: Log with stray escape  and bell  and null � character
cases.stored: Log with stray escape  and bell  and null  character
cases.display: Log with stray escape  and bell  and null  character

cases.name: logfmt msg=
cases.line: time="2026-10-03T14:56:31Z" level=info msg="Successfully refreshed custom fields cache with 0 fields."
cases.stored: Successfully refreshed custom fields cache with 0 fields.
cases.display: Successfully refreshed custom fields cache with 0 fields.

cases.name: Maintainerr app pipe
cases.line: [maintainerr] | 03/10/2026 16:00:33  [INFO] [RuleExecutorService] Execution of rules for 'Never Watched by Anyone' done.
cases.stored: [RuleExecutorService] Execution of rules for 'Never Watched by Anyone' done.
cases.display: [RuleExecutorService] Execution of rules for 'Never Watched by Anyone' done.

cases.name: Valkey / Redis
cases.line: 1:M 02 Oct 2026 11:47:57.745 # Warning: No config file specified, using the default config.
cases.stored: Warning: No config file specified, using the default config.
cases.display: No config file specified, using the default config.

cases.name: Plain sentence starting with Error
cases.line: Error on Supervisor API: Timeout connecting to Supervisor
cases.stored: Error on Supervisor API: Timeout connecting to Supervisor
cases.display: Error on Supervisor API: Timeout connecting to Supervisor
